recipe.visualDefinition: A stark black-and-white composition featuring a vertical rectangular portrait centered on a white field, flanked by asymmetrical typography that overlaps the image boundary.
coreVisualRelationships: High-contrast subject against a deep black background within a defined frame
Large display serif text overlapping the left edge of the central image
Small, wide-tracked secondary text anchored to the bottom margin
Balance between the dense black image core and the expansive white negative space

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is a close-up portrait contained within a vertical rectangle that occupies the central 40% of the horizontal width.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The high-contrast face of the subject acts as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the large text on the left, move into the subject's gaze, and drop down to the small text at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy use of white space on the left and right margins to isolate the central vertical column.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Pure white background providing negative space.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black for the image background and typography.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Mid-tone grays within the photographic subject for texture.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation; extreme value contrast between black and white.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Classical serif with high stroke contrast.
letterConstructionRules: Large display text uses bracketed serifs and teardrop terminals
Secondary text uses all-caps with extreme letter spacing
Sharp transitions between thick and thin strokes

composition.overlap: Partial overlap with the image container

composition.position: Bottom center, aligned with image width

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Scale contrast: one large, bold serif paired with one small, light, widely-spaced serif.
graphicDevices: Hard-edged rectangular frame for the photograph

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the elegant, high-contrast serif structure of the display text.
Provides the necessary vertical stress and sharp serifs.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast black and white portrait of a man with a moody expression, contained within a sharp vertical rectangle centered on a pure white background. The man's face should be well-lit against a dark, grainy background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place a large serif word in black on the left side, overlapping the edge of the portrait. Add a line of small, widely-spaced uppercase serif text centered at the bottom.

verificationChecks: Does the large text overlap the image border?
Is the bottom text widely tracked?

adjustableVariables: Width of the central image rectangle
Amount of overlap for the display text
Intensity of film grain in the photo
Tracking width of the bottom text
mustRedesign: Changing the font to a sans-serif

mustAchieve: Sharp, clean edges on the image frame
Deep, rich blacks in the photo

postGenerationChecks: Check for pure black and white values
Ensure text is legible and sharp
Verify the vertical alignment of the image container
Confirm the asymmetrical balance feels intentional
recipe.reuseFormula: Vertical high-contrast B&W photo + Overlapping display serif + Wide-tracked footer text + Expansive white margins.
